title: Sir Pangolin, knight of the termite mound
storyboard: Film: none; AI-generate a pangolin knight in keratin 'armour' rolling into a ball; label clips AI-generated

scenes.headline: Sir Pangolin of the Termite Mound reports for duty
His armour? Not metal. Fingernail.
scenes.body: Pangolin scales are made of keratin, the same material as your nails and hair.

scenes.headline: Pangolins are thought to be the most trafficked wild mammal
scenes.body: Tens of thousands are poached every year for their scales and meat.

caption:
No dragons were harmed. Pangolins, sadly, are.

Pangolins look like anteaters and armadillos, but they're more closely related to bears, cats and dogs.

Source: National Geographic (Pangolins).  Photos/video: Wikimedia Commons (credits on screen).
notes: Absurd AI knight story with every gag tied to a real trait, ending on a real conservation message. The real reel carries an 'AI-generated' label on AI clips; real tree pangolin photos stand in here.
